segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Some people asked me how do you best protect your Facebook ad sets from getting banned?

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So if you guys are new, getting banned from Facebook Ads is a very real reality that happens happens very, very often.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Even if you're drop shipping, starting a new brand,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: it just happens.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Recently, as I'm filming this in October 2025, there's been a ban wave that caused a lot of people to be banned.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So I'm going to teach you how to actually set it up so everything is proper, you won't have issues of getting banned.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So we're going to set up three Business Managers, or optionally two.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: The first Business Manager will only host the pixel

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: and be inside the Business Manager, you want to ensure that you have three profiles that are all admin.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: We only admin all of these because we're only going to use real profiles.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: You might have heard people ask you to buy assets from from sellers, you know, aged assets or whatever it may be.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: I'm telling you that having real profiles as in your own profile, friends and families, your parents, sisters, brothers

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: is going to be the most legit one.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: If you buy assets, you run the risk of getting

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: hacked, it's a big one,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: getting banned is is another big one as well.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: They can easily hack your your ad spend while you're spending halfway and steal your money. It's It's something that happens.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Which is why you you ideally don't want to buy any assets. You only want to create it through your own profile.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So first of all, you need to get these profiles, use your own, your family, friends, whoever it is. That's the best

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: 'cause those are most legit.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So these three profiles are going to be admin on all of these BMs.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So they're the same three admins

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: in all these BMs.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: That's for the profile level.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: On a BM level,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: one BM will host pixel only, meaning you create the pixel on this Business Manager.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So no matter how many stores you're running, all the pixels are run through this one Business Manager.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: And then the second Business Manager is going to be a holding BM.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: I put it as optional

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: because whether you should have two or three, it depends on whether you have, like, a company incorporated.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Why?

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: If you have a company incorporated like LLC or LTD, you can verify the BM. Then instead of having these two, BM two and three,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: the ad accounts go under BM two. Then it's just the pixel BM and ad account BM.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: If you verify it, it becomes stronger, and there's a whole lot of benefits to it:

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: more ad account limits, your spend limit on the ad account gets goes higher,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: etc. Performance-wise, it's all the same.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Let's say if you don't have that, then you need to have three BMs.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: A holding BM, you don't do anything on it. There's no assets in it.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: You just share your pixels into here.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: You share your ad account into here.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Then you run all the ads on BM two, but actually the the assets are hosted on BM one and three.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: The reason we do all of this,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: if let's say something happens to to you run everything on one BM,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: it gets banned, your pixel gets screwed, your ad account gets screwed.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: You lose all two things together.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Whereas if you do it this way, if BM two gets banned, you still maintain your pixel and your ad account.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Or worst case, your ad account gets banned,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: you still have your pixel. You still have something. It's not the end of the world.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So that's what why we use assets like this. It's how you protect yourself.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: But if you have an LLC, you can verify your Business Manager,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: I myself, I would just use put this over here. You don't need the holding BM.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Once you verify the Business Manager, it becomes more, what's the word for it, solid, less likely to get banned.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So then you just need to share the pixel BM, the pixel only, to the second BM.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: It's pretty straightforward.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So profiles are set, pixel set, ad account set.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: The only last thing besides here is just your page.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: The page shouldn't be created on a Business Manager level, it should be created on the profile level.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: I'll show you guys in a subsequent video of how to do that.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Hopefully this all makes sense. So either you have two or three BMs, and everything, all the assets will be separated out.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: The profiles for each of the BM will be the same. Since you're running real profiles from real people, there's not much risk to it.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: These three are fine to be admin on all.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Make sure that you have the admin. Don't only leave one admin 'cause if your profile gets banned and you're the only admin, no one else can access the Business Manager also.
